title: Junior Developer Jobs in 2026 Are Brutal Here's Why
description:
Why is it so hard to get a junior developer job in 2026? If you have zero experience, you're fighting an uphill battle. Companies now expect entry-level developers to perform like the mid or senior engineers of 5-6 years ago. 

The grunt work juniors used to do — writing unit tests, typing out routine code — is disappearing, which means expectations have jumped and the effort required to break into software engineering is higher than it's ever been.

#techwithtim #techjobs #softwareengineering #programming
